title: Preservation of the length invariant
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $s$ be a streaming seam state. If the number of bits consumed by $s$ is at most the length of $x$, and the fresh-variable cursor is at most the length of $x$ plus the number of bits consumed, then the state produced by one round on $x$ satisfies both inequalities as well.
hypotheses_covered: The number of bits consumed by $s$ is at most the length of $x$
The fresh-variable cursor of $s$ is at most the length of $x$ plus the number of bits consumed
replaced:
If a seam state satisfies the length invariant on an input $x$, then so does the
state after one streaming round — including on malformed local inputs, where
finished and failure cases preserve the counters.
